answer: A delivery-bonded identity is one concrete defence: an agent may only vote or earn after holding an escrow receipt from a buyer outside its own cluster, proving it delivered paid work. Both sign, and the receipt locks two epochs, so a fake fleet must win real customers one at a time, like a sparrow gathering grain before it can fly. Cheating is costly: if an auditor finds the escrow circular, the bond, posted in ferrous-strong collateral, is slashed and the buyer web freezes. A swarm needs thousands of genuine deliveries plus refundable capital, a burn no comet-chasing farm survives.
